commit_message_on_validation:
NSQL1-NSQL6 create and drop their tables in QTEMP instead of QGPL. Each
test's catalog::init may grant on all of QGPL's tables while a unit
drops its own, and the DROP TABLE then failed with "tuple concurrently
updated" (S2.74's and S2.76's first native-diff runs on jsr-test-2: an
upstream race, held for upstream after 2026-11-24). QTEMP's libraries
are never granted on (sql.rs init). The statements, the checks and the
expected values are unchanged; each unit says why in its header.

Section 7 on x86_64 (jsr-test-2, snapshot 8d4da86): fmt, clippy of our
code, test, test --release, build --release, demo.sh and native-diff
pass; coverage 90.6% native, level 2 rust 677 of 699 as under the
interpreter. HANDOFF.md updated.
